# porch_resource (Resource)

An authorization resource of a tenant (e.g. a media library or a folder) that role assignments can be scoped to; resources form a hierarchy through `parent_id`. Its attributes are visible to policies as `resource.attributes`. Needs `resource:manage`. Import with `<tenant>/<resource_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "porch_resource" "movies" {
  tenant = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  type   = "library"
  slug   = "movies"
  name   = "Movies"

  attributes = {
    rating = "pg"
  }
}

resource "porch_resource" "cartoons" {
  tenant    = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  type      = "library"
  slug      = "cartoons"
  name      = "Cartoons"
  parent_id = porch_resource.movies.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Identifier, unique per type in the tenant. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `tenant` (String) ID or slug of the tenant that owns this object. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `type` (String) Lowercase type identifier (`app` and `tenant` are reserved). Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `attributes` (Map of String) String attributes (at most 50; values up to 512 bytes).
- `parent_id` (String) ID of the parent resource. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ID (`res_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porch_resource.movies <tenant>/<resource_id>
```
